subject: science
topicName: Balancing Chemical Equations: Practice and Strategies
description: Practice balancing simple chemical equations by changing coefficients, counting atoms on both sides, and checking that each equation follows the Law of Conservation of Mass.
learningObjectives: Balance simple chemical equations by adjusting coefficients
Count atoms of each element on both sides of a chemical equation
Explain why coefficients may be changed but subscripts must stay fixed
Use a systematic strategy to balance equations involving hydrogen, oxygen, metals, and simple compounds
prerequisites: Reactants and products in a chemical equation
Counting atoms in formulas such as H2O, O2, CO2, and NH3
